svg.title: Imen Bouchriha — afterglow identity card
svg.desc: Animated neon afterglow card: slowly breathing, dissolving edges, a drifting ember field, film grain and a gentle float. Bottom-left overlay reads: software engineer, full-stack — Imen Bouchriha, always building something after midnight, signed.

g.text: Half engineer, half designer — always building after midnight.
